qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Installed base servicing and automation systems provide recurring revenue, but large-scale pulp, paper, and energy machinery capital projects dilute returns and lack pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Capital equipment division (~50% of revenue) involves large, lumpy, negotiated project tenders for pulp and board mills with intense competition. Multi-cycle after-tax GAAP ROIC sits at 7-10%, failing the 12% minimum hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Comparable pre-tax ROCE of 12.7% (2024) and 13.0% (2025) corresponds to an after-tax ROIC of approximately 8-10%, well below the 12% threshold. Capital project orders are cyclical and subject to fierce price competition from Andritz and Voith.
